subject: Extract and document ZFS OSv modifications
description:
Phase 1 of ZFS update: Scan all files with __OSV__ guards and create structured patch system.

Tasks:
1. Identify all files with __OSV__ modifications (scan bsd/sys/cddl/contrib/opensolaris/)
2. Create patch directory structure: bsd/sys/cddl/osv-patches/
3. Generate patches for each modification:
   - 001-vdev-disk-osv-bio.patch (complete vdev_disk.c rewrite)
   - 002-arc-memory-shrinker.patch (ARC memory management)
   - 003-zfs-context-threading.patch (threading API adaptations)
   - 004-zfs-vfsops-integration.patch (VFS layer)
   - 005-io-async-callback.patch (async I/O completion)
4. Document integration points in bsd/sys/cddl/osv-patches/INTEGRATION.md:
   - Constructor function pattern (fs/zfs/zfs_initialize.c:60)
   - Callback registrations
   - VFS operation override via zfs_update_vfsops()
   - Memory locking annotation

Critical files:
- All files in bsd/sys/cddl/contrib/opensolaris/ with __OSV__ guards
- fs/zfs/zfs_initialize.c (callbacks and initialization)

Timeline: 1-2 weeks
